sn51.13:1.1: “Bhikkhus, if a bhikkhu depends on enthusiasm in order to gain concentration, gain mental stillness,
sn51.13:1.2: this is called concentration due to enthusiasm.
sn51.13:1.3: They generate enthusiasm, try, make an effort, exert the mind, and strive so that bad, unskillful qualities don’t arise.
sn51.13:1.4: They generate enthusiasm, try, make an effort, exert the mind, and strive so that bad, unskillful qualities that have arisen are given up.
sn51.13:1.5: They generate enthusiasm, try, make an effort, exert the mind, and strive so that skillful qualities arise.
sn51.13:1.6: They generate enthusiasm, try, make an effort, exert the mind, and strive so that skillful qualities that have arisen remain, are not lost, but increase, mature, and are fulfilled by development.
sn51.13:1.8: And so there is this enthusiasm, this concentration due to enthusiasm, and these active efforts.
sn51.13:1.9: This is called the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to enthusiasm, and active effort.
sn51.13:2.1: If a bhikkhu depends on energy in order to gain concentration, gain mental stillness,
sn51.13:2.2: this is called concentration due to energy.
sn51.13:2.3: They generate enthusiasm, try, make an effort, exert the mind, and strive so that bad, unskillful qualities don’t arise …
sn51.13:2.4: so that skillful qualities that have arisen remain, are not lost, but increase, mature, and are fulfilled by development.
sn51.13:2.6: And so there is this energy, this concentration due to energy, and these active efforts.
sn51.13:2.7: This is called the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to energy, and active effort.

sn51.13:3.2: this is called concentration due to mental development.

sn51.13:3.6: And so there is this mental development, this concentration due to mental development, and these active efforts.
sn51.13:3.7: This is called the basis of psychic power that has concentration due to mental development, and active effort.

sn51.13:4.2: this is called concentration due to inquiry.
